measurement_timing.train: train_MSE/MAE are reduced over the epoch's pre-update training pass (all 19 windows and all nodes/horizons)
measurement_timing.validation: validation_MSE/MAE are measured after the epoch's single optimizer step

selection.chunk_order: ascending training window start, then ascending context; each chunk carries the complete context adjacency
selection.measurement_timing: validation scores are measured after the epoch's single optimizer step; training scores are measured over the pre-update epoch pass
selection.tie_break: earliest epoch on an exact validation-MSE tie
